LESSON: EARLIEST CONVERTS IN ISLAM • KHADIJA (R.A.) • ALI (R.A.) • ABUBAKAR (R.A.)

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.2: Earliest Converts in Islam • Khadija (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) • Abubakar (R.A.)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Earliest Converts in Islam • Khadija (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) • Abubakar (R.A.), part of History of Islam in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What role did the earliest converts play in the Prophet’s mission?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. mention the earliest converts in Islam (Khadija (R.a.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.), in pairs/groups, and write them in their notebook,

2. read from reference material/course books on the story of (Khadija (R.a.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) and write the role they played in the Prophet’s mission,

3. listen to a resource person discussing the role played by earliest converts. (e.g. First person to accept Islam, moral and material support, and lives),

4. listen to a story on Khadija (R.A), Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) from a resource person/digital device.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. mention the earliest converts in Islam (Khadija (R.a.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.), in pairs/groups, and write them in their notebook,
2. read from reference material/course books on the story of (Khadija (R.a.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) and write the role they played in the Prophet’s mission,
3. listen to a resource person discussing the role played by earliest converts. (e.g. First person to accept Islam, moral and material support, and lives),
4. listen to a story on Khadija (R.A), Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) from a resource person/digital device.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Earliest Converts in Islam • Khadija (R.A.) • Ali (R.A.) • Abubakar (R.A.) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening, speaking and writing as learners identify the qualities that led

Khadija (R.A) to propose to marry the Prophet (e.g. trustworthy, honesty, hardworking), in pairs/groups, and write the points

in their notebook

• Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge as learners listen to a resource person discussing the role of Khadija

in the life of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W). (e.g. First person to accept Islam, moral support, all his children were born by

Khadija apart from Ibrahim, her wealth support).

Values:
Respect: etiquette enhanced as learners listen attentively to a resource person discussing the role of Khadija in the life of Prophet

Muhammad (S.A.W).

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: Nationalism by volunteering in Islamic activities in the community.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Social Studies as learners learn on personalities and their role in the country or different community development.
